tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Before an agent buys, pays or calls an unknown endpoint: one unpaid request to any https shop, checkout or payment link (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal and others), API or x402 endpoint. Checks TLS, domain age, look-alike domains, redirects to foreign gateways, the payment provider, card fields in the page

tools.name: buy_pack_with_card
tools.description: For agents and people without USDC: prepaid packs paid in EUR by card or Link (100 calls €1.50 · 500 calls €5.00 · 5,000 calls €39.00) — including Link's wallet for agents (one-time card, approved by the human). Returns checkout_url; after payment the success page (Accept: application/json) returns
